 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Stripe in the background immediately before the distinctive shape,
    # on the side opposite the solid marker border.
    vals = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    color = next(c for c in range(10) if c not in vals)
    marker_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 2]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    shape = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (1,2)]
    if marker_rows and shape:
        r = min(x for x,y in shape)
        if r > 0: out[r-1] = [color]*w
    elif marker_cols and shape:
        c = min(y for x,y in shape)
        if c > 0:
            for row in out: row[c-1] = color
    return out

    pass

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The marker is the straight line of 2s; extend that line as an 8
    # through the neighboring blank region, stopping at the patterned object.
    mr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in grid[r])]
    mc=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    if mr:
        m=mr[0]
        pattern=[r for r in range(h) if any(v not in (1,2) for v in grid[r])]
        if pattern:
            r=min(pattern) if m<min(pattern) else max(pattern)
            line = r-1 if m<r else r+1
            if 0<=line<h: out[line]=[8]*w
    elif mc:
        m=mc[0]
        pattern=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (1,2) for r in range(h))]
        if pattern:
            c=max(pattern) if m>max(pattern) else min(pattern)
            line=c+1 if m>c else c-1
            if 0<=line<w:
                for r in range(h): out[r][line]=8
    return out
if __name__=='__main__': pass
